segments.en: What is this place?! It's pure white -- I can't see a thing!
Looks like there's an atmosphere?
Seems like we're inside a cloud... It's almost all water vapor.
There's gravity?!
Looks that way. We don't have enough thrust -- we're descending!
We're out of the clouds?!
There's a continent down there...?!
Looks like we're not in space...
Didn't we just come straight down to Earth?
I don't know...
While we can, get pictures of the terrain from up here!
Hm?!
There's something over there!!
Cruiser sighted ahead! It's a Clop-class!
Oh... So there was another ship besides ours that came through the gate.
It's being tossed about by the air currents and wobbling... A damaged ship?
If it lost its steering and wandered into this airspace by chance, it's a lucky ship...
Indeed... Had its approach to the gate been off course, it would have burned up in the atmosphere.
Registry confirmed. It's a Londo Bell ship!
What...?
Lord Omega... We have reports that Kanji Akatsuki was assigned to Londo Bell.
Are you saying it's no accident that they came...?
However, I'd think it difficult to pinpoint the gate with an FT's equipment alone...
Still less do I believe Kanji Akatsuki has any great analytical ability. He's a lucky man, though...
Perhaps a Newtype guided them...
With Londo Bell... that's conceivable...
Hurry, get away!
But hey, that's a Federation ship, right? Isn't it on our side?
Either way, at this rate it's only a matter of time before we crash-land.
Shouldn't we ask them for help?
Whoa! They're contacting us!
I am the commander of this ship, Omega Fokurosu.
We are prepared to rescue your crew. Is the person in charge of your ship present?
Ah, uh, umm... The person in charge, huh...
In this case... it's gotta be Kanji, right?
Heeey! Kanji!
What? Where'd that guy go?
You there! Did you just... say Kanji?!
Huh? What's up?
Is Kanji Akatsuki aboard?!
Kanji's here, all right! So what's it to you?
We've got somewhere we need to go!!
We don't need you to rescue us, thanks!!
Whoa, whoa! Quess! Let's keep this a little friendlier.
If that ship answers to Kanji, I'll sink it right here!
H-Hey, wait a second!
We're Federation forces, y'know! You guys are on our side, right?
This world is not the space we were in until moments ago -- much less the Earth Sphere!
Therefore, our army is not the Earth Federation Forces!
If you value your lives, abandon ship at once! I'll at least spare your lives.
Lord Omega!! Enemy unit approaching!!
What?!
Figured you'd pull something like that! Omega!!
Kanji, it's you...!
If you're going to attack, I'll destroy your ship's engines!
Luckily for me, I know this ship's layout pretty well.
Fighting here would only end with us taking each other down...
Very well... I'll withdraw for now.
What's this? You're awfully cooperative.
Someday, you and I must settle things.
Until then, don't you go dying some pointless death.
Kanji, you're pretty good!
Quit teasing! I'm a veteran pilot, believe it or not.
Whoa! The ship still isn't stable?
What's going on? We're drifting!
Can't be helped, can it? The helm's barely worked from the start!
If we're making a forced landing, hurry! At this rate, we'll end up out over the Sea of Clouds!
The Sea of Clouds?! You mean that thing we can see right ahead?
If this ship goes out over the Sea of Clouds, it won't last even a few minutes!
To fly over the Sea of Clouds, you need a Cloud Ship.
Ngh...! Hey! Kanji!
What do you mean the ship won't last?!
Well, to put it in terms you guys would get...
it'd burn up, like when you enter Earth's atmosphere.
Looks like we've ended up someplace pretty crazy, huh?
Little late to be whining about it now!
You guys! This is no time to sit around chatting!
Do something! More to the right, I said!
This is the best I can do!
Never mind that, just drop us onto land!
Fine! It's gonna get a little rough, but here we go!!
That's insane!!
Yieee~! Gods and Buddhas, save me~!!
Ow ow ow ow ow...
Owww~ We should've come down in the Dragonars...
Still... what kind of world is this, anyway?
Seems fundamentally different from Earth's natural environment.
Yeah... There was a Sea of Clouds all around the continent...
It's called a "Sea of Clouds," but it isn't just water vapor, right?
Yeah... It only looks like clouds. As for what kind of substance it really is...
nobody even knows whether it's a "substance" at all.
So, basically, we just stay away from it, right?
Whoa!
What is it this tiiime?
Something's coming at us from over there!!
What? This feeling...

segments.en: That treasure's ours for the taking!
Boys! Don't you screw this up!!
They're not even gonna talk?!
Doesn't look like they're the type you can reason with.
That lot? They're all show.
They're nothing much in terms of firepower.
Let's send 'em packing! And then we'll make the prisoners tell us all kinds of stuff!
Right! Let's fight back!!
What's with these guys... They've got a lot more backbone than I thought!
It's your own fault for taking us lightly!
Nuooh! What a bunch!!
Any more of this and it won't be worth the cost...!
Fall back! Fall baaack!
You're not getting away! We've got questions for you guys!!
Hold it! More of them are coming!!
These guys... What the heck are they!
Doesn't look like they're friendly.
Hey! Without resupply, we can't keep fighting!
How about we just play nice and try surrendering?
That might beat fighting recklessly, but...
It's fine. If we just stay put like this...
Huh?!
Kanji! Are you there?
Amuro!! How did you...?!
Save the talk for later. We'll take them down with the Iron Gear! Stay hidden for a while.
Iron... Gear?
Well, I'll be. It's just like Quess said.
But what's that supposed to mean, "stay put"?
It means we just sit back and watch.
This is a warning to all Breakers gathered here!
I am Elchi Cargo of the Iron Gear!
Friends of ours are aboard that ship! I won't allow you to lay a hand on it!
Who cares! Let 'em have it!!
Oh, you've done it now!!
All hands! Battle stations!!
That's what I've been waiting for! Let's go, Amuro!
Yeah... We're protecting that ship no matter what!
I know, I know. They're your precious guests, right?
All riiight! Here we gooo!

rows.notes: [17] Breaker speaker (rough, possibly female speech in the JP) kept gender-neutral. [22] Rag answering Amuro: 'your guests' = the Londo Bell ship's crew. | [accuracy 12] referent: 'he' pointed at Amuro, but Amuro said 'stay hidden'; 'stay put' ([jp]) is Quess's phrase from k5 -- source names no one, kept impersonal | [editorial 9] 'We'll talk later. We'll suppress them' doubled 'We'll' and stiff 'suppress' | [editorial 14] 'I warn all Breakers' stilted for a loudspeaker announcement

segments.en: You think you can take us on with a force this puny?
By the looks of it, that Land Ship's all show too.
All units launched! Done!
Then here we go!
Iron Gear, transform!!
Aye aye!!
What? Hey... Waaaaah!
Don't get spooked!! That's just a bluff!
Fire! Fiiire! Keep shooting!!
The enemy's rattled! Drive them off with every turret at once!!
Now that's a captain!
Fiiire!!
Waaaaaaah!!
Fall back! Fall baaack!
You're wide open!
Amuro's amazing.
That's Amuro for ya!
All riiight, my turn!!
Tch! Here they come!! Hit 'em back!!
Gkh! Damn you, Walker Gallia!
Bossss! We can't hold out!!
Can't enjoy the loot if you're dead! We're pulling out!!
Looks like it's over.
Cease fire! Undo the transformation.
You got it!

rows.notes: Breaker speakers kept gender-neutral; [jp] rendered 'Boss'. [21] [jp] idiom -> 'can't enjoy the loot if you're dead'. | [editorial 1] [jp]: 'At this rate' implied progression; 'Land Ship' per project decision | [editorial 10] [jp] cheer: 'Way to go, great captain!' awkward | [proofread 5] style sheet: 'Aye aye' (no hyphen)

segments.en: Heeey! Lieutenant Amuro!
The whole Dragonar Team's here!
Is Londo Bell going to be all right?
We had Kayra stay behind, so the mobile suit team'll be fine.
Besides, the fight with Neo Zeon is heading toward a temporary ceasefire.
I see...
Still, it turned out just like Quess said.
You said it. I never thought we'd find you this easily.
Quess...? She's here?
Yeah. Actually, we only made it here thanks to her.
She kept saying you and Char were alive over here, see.
I see... Quess did...
I feel like I'm starting to get what this Newtype thing is about, a little.
Heeey! Amurooo! Where's the help you mentioned?
Jiron! Over here!
Hey! I'm Jiron Amos. Good to meetcha!
I'm Kanji Akatsuki. Thanks for having us.
I'm Rag Uralo.
Well, if you're Amuro's friends, you must know your stuff, right?
Looks like you've got your own machines, too.
Leave it all to us, and you can rest easy!
Don't go deciding that so easily!
Hm? What's with that girl? Pretty unfriendly, isn't she?
Ah... She's...
I don't have to give my name to someone who might end up an enemy.
Whaaat?! I introduced myself!
And after we just saved your hides, too!
I don't remember asking you to.
Quess! There you go, making enemies again!
That's right. In that last fight, too, Quess said it'd be fine, so...
I was just using the situation.
What did you say?!
Don't get the wrong idea. Until recently, I was enemies with Amuro and his people.
Oh, yeah?! Then why don't you just get lost!
I will! You're nothing but a gang of outlaws!
Why, you little...!
Quess! That's enough!!
What?!
I can't just leave you here like this.
You're coming with us!
Hmph!
H-Hey! Quess!
Hmm... Do girls always butt heads like that?
Of course not!
Amuro... Anyway, I don't want any troublemakers.
Sorry. She's still just a kid...
A lot happened before she came here...
We'll look after her, so cut her some slack.
Phew... Guess it can't be helped...
You there! Stop dawdling!
We won't make it to the bazaar in time!
Get the cargo loaded, pronto! We're leaving right away!!
Oh? Seems like she's in a hurry.
That's the captain of our Iron Gear.
I'll fill you in on the details as we go.
For now, bring everything that looks useful aboard the Iron Gear.
Got it. Let's get to it, everyone!
Yeah!!
Captain! We've loaded everything that looked useful.
Good work!
Iron Gear! Set out for the Bazaar Point!!
(The Iron Gear, huh...)
(I just got here, so... I don't know my way around at all...)
(......! The ship's started moving...?)
(Where on earth are we headed...?)
(...Well, for now, I guess I'll take a walk around the ship...)

rows.notes: [0] [jp] -> 'Captain Amuro' (rank). [13] [jp] = the help Amuro brought/mentioned. [20] [jp] idiom -> 'you can rest easy'. [46] whose 'before coming here' read as Quess's. [32] [jp] -> 'Amuro and his people'. | [editorial 26] subject: the Iron Gear crew did the rescue (accuracy flag offered 'we'); Rag speaks for the crew | [editorial 32] 'Amuro and his people and I were enemies' clumsy chain | [editorial 62] [jp] idiom: 'left from my right' too literal (accuracy flag)

segments.en: Heyyy, how's it goin'!!
What? So you guys are the new recruits?
Yeah.
Hmm... How'd softies like you ever survive this long?
Listen up! I'm the great Blume.
I'm gonna work you to the bone, so be ready!
Go easy on us.
The Iron Gear's short-handed as it is.
Anyone caught slacking off gets straightened out!
Blume! Stop that.
Elchi! With guys like these, you gotta set 'em straight from the start.
Call me Captain!
Yeah, yeah...!
Pardon him, everyone.
I'm the captain, Elchi Cargo.
Welcome aboard the Iron Gear! We're glad to have you!
Wow~ I'm surprised a beauty like you is the captain.
Oh my~ A beauty? Stop it, you~
Hey, Kaine, isn't cheating kinda bad?
Ahahahahaha!
But hey, with a beautiful captain, the work's a lot more rewarding.
Exactly!
Jeez! What a frivolous bunch~ They're nothing like Amuro...
Hahaha... I bet.
Amuro told me about you all. It seems you specialize in fighting with machines.
Well, we were in the military, so I guess that's about right...?
I see... So you're ex-military...
I'm sure you understand, but we're strictly "haulers."
So my policy is to avoid fighting as much as possible.
I understand.
It's not like we've been fighting because we like it, either.
That's right. Not fighting beats fighting any day!
Wonderful! Maybe you're more cultured than I thought.
Cultured...?
Well, sure. Compared to other gloomy soldiers, we're way more cultured.
But if guys like that bunch earlier are swarming around...
is it really much different from a war?
Yeah... This ship's got plenty of weapons on it, too.
Mmm... That's the thing. There are so many barbarians around...
And here I am, aiming to be a cultured hauler...!
That kinda talk is why we're short-handed!
Shut up! If you don't like it, get off!
Now listen, everyone. This ship may sometimes be forced to fight in self-defense.
But fighting is not our business!
We haulers are approved by each continent's government to cross their borders.
Being allowed to trade at the designated Bazaar Points is, you might say, a "hauler's" privilege.
From now on, I want you to take pride in being "haulers" too, and work hard!
Understood!
Now, I'll give you your first job.
This ship is currently heading for a Bazaar Point.
But on the way, guys like that bunch earlier will come after our cargo.
Until we reach the bazaar, take turns keeping watch around the ship.
Roger that!
Hmm... Feels like we're doing the same thing as before.
Now, now, don't say that, Tapp my boy!
Captain Elchi! After work, let's have a cultured chat.
Nice! Maybe throw a welcome party or something!
A party? Oh, right, that IS cultured, isn't it?
Captain!!
Ah, ahem!
All right, dismissed!
Well then, see ya!
Elchi, compared to your old man, you're kinda short on dignity.
Can't be helped! That's just how things turned out!
Haaah... A girl as young as me...
having to be the boss of a hauler outfit...! Poor me...
Whining at this point? You're no tragic heroine.
The only thing you're good at is talking...!
We are on course for the Bazaar Point, I hope.
Like I'd get it wrong.
Fine, then! Make sure we get there on time.
Yeah, yeah...!

rows.notes: [jp] = 'haulers' (library-entry form). [18] [jp] joke at Kaine (cheating on his girl back home). [54] [jp] -> 'Tapp my boy' for Light's teasing tone. [62] [jp] = Elchi's late father -> 'your old man'. | [editorial 27] [jp]: 'first and last' unidiomatic | [editorial 60] 'Now, dismissed!' awkward

segments.en: Picked up a Land Ship approaching. I'm sending you the image, so take a look.
Whoa! An image came through.
Wow~ This thing's handy~
This is no time to be impressed!
Tell us whether they're enemies!
Hmm... I can't really tell from this alone.
Bro! The Iron Gear's shown up!
Looks like they broke through the patrol we sent out.
They're tough. Small-fry Breakers can't take them down.
We'll hit them once they're worn out! That's all part of the plan.
Commence the operation!! Get everyone to battle stations!
Roger!
Walker Machines are coming out!
Don't tell me they want a fight?
Hey! We've got an incoming transmission!!
Miss Elchi, it's been a long time.
...What? Is that you, Horla?
What a pest! That's no way for a man to act!!
We're here to take part in the bazaar! Let us through!!
That's... a request I can't grant!
The Grados Army has asked us to investigate the Iron Gear, you see.
Seems the Grados Army has business with the "outsiders" aboard the Iron Gear.
What did you say?!
...Nobody told me about that!
Our rights are supposed to be protected by intercontinental ordinances.
Even the Grados Army has no right to pull something like this!
Outsiders... Doesn't that mean us?
You're saying Grados knows who we are...?
We can't go causing trouble for the Iron Gear.
Yeah...
What are you talking about! We're comrades, aren't we!
Right?! Elchi!!
Ugh...
What'll it be? If you like, I could sink you right now, no problem.
It'd just get written off as a squabble between haulers!
Damn it! What a creep!
If Amuro and the others leave, we won't make it from here on!
Elchi!! At this point, we've just gotta see it through!
Oh, fine! Commence battle! We're driving off Kid Horla!!
That's more like it!
Let's go, everyone!
Yeah!!
Hmph! Seems words won't get through to you!

rows.notes: [0] Light reporting to Elchi on the bridge. [17] [jp] = 'Miss Elchi' / 'miss' (Horla's fawning-polite tone). [19] [jp] kept as 'no way for a man to act'. segments.en: Looks like the enemy ship's pulling back. Want to give chase?
Wait! Horla himself is nowhere to be seen!
Haven't seen him over here either.
Maybe he never came out at all?
No way!
Where'd that creep go and hide!!
That Horla~ always getting in my way...!
What a cruel thing to say. And here I thought I was helping you out...
Huh! Horla?!
Heh... So those are your prized hired hands?
Throwing your weight around with big hulking machines, yet you can't keep out one intruder. How pathetic...
We're just short-handed! We're going to the bazaar to recruit crew right now!
You won't find many Breakers you can trust.
Wake up already, miss!
There's hardly any of your old friends left anymore, is there?
Ugh~ So...! What's your point?!
Brats from the Sand Rats... and robot jockeys nobody knows anything about...
Keep company with them, and you'll really end up "wanted"...!
Hmph! As long as I keep to the haulers' rules, I'll be fine!
You're naive! Once you're branded "wanted," you won't be recognized as a hauler!
If that happens, not only will you be unable to leave this continent, but the Grados regulars will attack you.
I know that!
Then either you throw them off the Iron Gear... or marry me... and come with me...
It's one or the other, isn't it?
Wh-Why does it come to that!
It's not too late yet. Please, come with me!
No! No way! Like I'd ever be your bride!
All you want is the Cargo family's rights, isn't it?
Th-That's not true!
How dare you say that...!
As if I'd believe you!!
Besides, I don't like Grados's policies!!
Destroying the old cultures and forcing only their own culture on everyone -- what kind of policy is that!!
I'll never become one of their lackeys!!
Miss! If the "Culture Correction Squad" heard you say that, you'd be in serious trouble!
Heeey! Elchi, it's about time to transform...
Ah! You!!
Out of my way!
Guhh!!
Horla!!
Whoa!!
You know how good I am with a knife!
Get out right now, or next time I really will hit you!
Heh... What'll it be, Mr. Kid?
Nnngh...
Miss! I won't give up!
Elchiii! You okay?
Yes, I'm fine.
Like I'd go down that easily!
Looks like we caused you some trouble.
If you think so, get back to the ship right away and do your maintenance!
Blume! We're out of time, so we'll head straight into the Bazaar Point.
Aye aye!

rows.notes: [2] Blume: 'that one' = Horla, gender-neutral. [22] [jp] (singular) read as the outsiders collectively -> 'them'; could mean one person (Amuro?). [29] [jp] read as Elchi's outrage at the marriage scheme/denial. [jp] -> 'Culture Correction Squad' (not in glossary, unverified). [jp] -> 'Sand Rats'. | [editorial 1] [jp]: 'Horla, the one who matters' clunky; Horla's gender (m) now known | [editorial 2] Horla is male (glossary); 'that one' workaround smoothed | [editorial 3] Horla is male; repeated name was a pronoun workaround | [editorial 20] 'not only won't you be able to ... , the ...' grammar/flow | [proofread 52] style sheet: 'Aye aye' (no hyphen)

segments.en:
Bazaar Point, here we are!
How about that? Right on schedule!

Looks like we made it
in time, somehow.

Let's get down to business right away!
Gather everyone in the hangar!

...And so, the Iron Gear will stay
here a while and do business.

Get your machine maintenance done fast,
then everyone join in the bazaar!

First bazaar in ages!
Let's all give it everything we've got!
Yeahhh!
Yeahhh!
Yeahhh!
Yeahhh!

Kanji!
Got a minute?
Sure, what is it?

I hear you're the one who
organizes the unit's formations.

I have to say,
I'm impressed.

Nah...
It's nothing special.

Heh... Well, it's about
to be something special!

To organize a unit, you need
all sorts of "equipment," right?

So, right off the bat, could you buy
whatever you think might come in handy?
Here, this is your war chest!
Obtained 10000 funds.

Whoa!
This much?!

From now on, I'm leaving equipment
purchases to you, Kanji.

Well, I'm off to mind the shop now,
so I'll leave the rest to you!
Hey... Captain!

Dammit...
I've totally lost sight of her...
Now, what am I supposed to do...

Hah hah!
She dumped the job right on you!

Eh, it's fine.
If it helps out even a little...

Say, have you ever
shopped at a bazaar before?

No...
Not even once...

This guy's gonna get
ripped off for sure!

Oh, fine... This time
I'll show you how it's done!
Follow me!

Hey, pal!
Come on over!

We've got the
good stuff here!

C'mon, c'mon!
If you dawdle, it'll
all be gone!

This is something...
They're selling seriously dangerous
weapons like they're vegetables.

These guys are
pretty much all crooks.

If you don't size things up properly,
you won't get anything decent.
*Gulp*...

Ah ha ha ha ha!
Aren't you cute!

And you're so brave
on the battlefield!
W-Well, I can't help it!

Today I'm gonna drill it all into you,
so make sure you learn it right!

Yes, ma'am!
I'm in your hands!

Okay!
We'll start over there!!

Phew...
Finally done...

I'm totally beat...
This is quite a job...

Still... today
I really owe Rag one...
Kanji, are you done on your end too?
Yeah, finally.

Hm...?
You look pretty worn out.

You okay?
Kanji...!
Yeah...

Sorry to bother you when you're tired,
but we'd like your help with one more job.
What kind of job?

Gathering information.
We were thinking of splitting up
and getting started now.

Of course I'll help!
We don't know a thing
about this continent, after all.

All right, then.
Let's get started.

There's still time.
I'll take a good look around.

rows.notes: 'Bazaar Point' capitalised as a location name ([jp]). Seg 15 answers Kanji's 'nothing special' ([jp]) with a matching pun for [jp]. Seg 19 follows the UI string 'Obtained %d funds.'. Seg 59 volitional [jp] read as Kanji to himself. | [editorial 3] [jp] opens the briefing; 'So that's the plan.' came before the plan it announced | [editorial 4] awkward 'Finish maintaining your machines quickly' | [editorial 43] 'teach you inside and out' unidiomatic for mitchiri oshieru

segments.en:
A bar, huh...
I bet it's full of
roughnecks and such...

Come on!
Get a grip, Kanji!

I got combat training
at the military academy!
Go in there with confidence!

Oh!
You came too, Kanji?

Don't just stand
around over there,
come over here!
Uh... s-sure...

Just so you know,
no drinking.

That's fine by me...
but why not?

If you've had a few, you can't move
when it counts, right?

You've gotta be able to
protect yourself!

I see,
so that's how it is.
Ow ow ow!

Why are YOU the one
acting impressed!
Guess it's almost time...

Well then,
I'll get going.
I've still got things to do.

Yeah?
Well, see you later.

Will Kanji be okay
on his own...?

Now, where should
I go next...

rows.notes: Seg 12: Rag scolds Jiron (a local) for being impressed by the no-drinking rule; seg 11 is his reaction to a smack. | [accuracy 13] sorosoro jikan ka = time is nearly up (he has to leave next line); 'About time, I guess' reads as 'finally'

segments.en:
Isn't that
Quess over there...?

Hey!
Quess!
Oh... Kanji.

It's dangerous to come
to a place like this alone.

What's wrong?
You look down again.

Yeah...
Sort of...

I was remembering the time
I trained in India...

India...
Does it look like this?

Nope!
Not really.

But now that you mention it...
maybe the smell of the wind
is kind of the same...?
I see...

I... I don't even understand
myself anymore...

I'm causing everyone
trouble, aren't I?

But it's thanks to you, Quess,
that we made it here.
You don't regret it?

Nope...
We made some new friends, too.

Thanks to that, little by little,
I'm starting to see the truth
of what's going on...
The truth...?

What Binzvanker is scheming...
that's what I want to get to the bottom of.

Oh, the boss of the organization
that staged the coup
in Claudia, right?

In space, we found out
they're tied in with
the Earth Federation Forces...

And then...
Omega showed up in this world, too...

Their organization may have grown
far bigger than we imagined.

Char... and Amuro...
they're both getting dragged into it...
I can see that now.
I see...

Would you know, Kanji?
What's going to happen
to the world from here on...

If I knew the future,
life would be a lot easier.
I guess not...

But hey, if more people who notice
what's wrong with the world join us...
there'll be peace someday!

That's the kind of future
I believe in.

Pfft... Aha!
Ahahahahahaha!
Wh-What?

You're so simple!
Ahahahahahaha!

What the?!
Were you making fun of me?

Ahahahaha!
Sorry, sorry!

It's just, you said it
out of nowhere.
That's harsh~

Well, I guess that's more like you,
Quess, so it's fine!
What's THAT supposed to mean~!

Ha ha ha...
Just a little payback.
Grrr~

Sorry to interrupt
your little chat!
Huh? Who are you?
Heh heh heh...

I don't make a habit of
introducing myself, but
I'll tell you two.

The name's
Timp Sharon.

Let's just say I'm
a wandering gunman.

Pleased to meet ya,
you two!

What are you trying to look cool for?!
What do you want with us?!
Old man!

Hmph... I'm not an old man!
I told you, it's Timp!!

You look like an old man
any way you slice it!
Hmph... Fine, whatever...

You two are pilots the
Iron Gear hired, right?

Yeah...
What about it?

If you stay on the Iron Gear,
nothing good's gonna come of it.

Take my advice.
Get off that ship
and come with me...!

Why?
We're getting along fine!

Captain Elchi's young, but we
can all back her up, and the
mood on board is great, y'know?

The Grados Army
is on the move.
The Grados Army?!

And what's this Grados Army
after, anyway?

Who knows...
I don't really get
what they're about either.

Point is, they're a major power that
invaded this continent
three years ago.

These days, everything around here
is Grados territory.

Unless you're a hauler, you can't
even move around freely.

I heard there's a rule that no power
can interfere with haulers
without good reason.

Which means somewhere
along the way, you must've
crossed the line, right?

The Iron Gear stands out
among all the hauling outfits.

Point is, once Grados
has its eye on you,
you're finished.

You two would be smart to
come with me right now, too.

Even so, we can't just
get off that ship
right now.

After all, we might be
part of the reason
for this ourselves.

Got some kind of obligation
to the Iron Gear, pal?

You can't have been running
with that crowd for
all that long...?
Thanks for the information, at least.
Let's go, Quess!
Okay!

Hey there,
pal!

Naive camaraderie won't
get you far in this world!
Maybe not...

But to me,
it feels like the right thing.

rows.notes: [jp] = 'hauler(s)' as in the library entry for Elchi. [jp] = 'old man' (Quess mocking Timp). [jp]/[jp] (Timp to Kanji) = 'pal'. Seg 73: Kanji means the 'outsiders' Grados is after (Kid Horla's earlier line). | [accuracy 76] contrastive wa restored: he thanks Timp for the info only, while refusing the offer | [editorial 20] 'I want' repeated across both halves; spoken cleft keeps the JP order | [editorial 28] 'wouldn't have it so rough' unidiomatic for kurou wa shinai

segments.en:
We'll be heading out soon.
Everyone, gather on the bridge.

So we're finally heading out...
I wonder where we're going next...

...And so, we're heading for a city
on the west coast, "Paradigm City."
Paradigm City?

Yeah, it's a gloomy town
where it's always overcast.

Sure, the old downtown
does have a dreary feel to it...

But that city sits right at
the junction linking the eastern
and western continents.

The center's
pretty well developed.

Maybe we'll finally get
some decent food for once.

All right, we're heading out.
Everyone, back to your posts.
Roger!

rows.notes: [jp] = 'old downtown' (the run-down lower town, as opposed to the developed [jp]). | [editorial 2] [jp] opens the briefing; 'So that's the plan.' came before the plan it announced (same as row 11 k3)

segments.en:
Let's set out for
Paradigm City!

There's a Land Ship
in our path.

Huh?
What a nuisance...
Couldn't it just move out of the way?

Attention, Iron Gear!
Disarm immediately
and surrender to us.

Huh?
Why?

That's...!
It's that old man from before!

If I remember right...
he said his name was Timp.
Why, that rat~!!

Hey!
Jiron!!

rows.notes: [editorial 0] bare imperative 'Set out for...' read oddly as Elchi's departure call | [editorial 3] stiff 'Could it please move aside?' for Elchi's dokete kurenai kashira | [editorial 8] accuracy flag: aitsu me milder than 'bastard'; matches Jiron's 'Timp, you rat!' (row 19 k3); 'bastard' kept for konno yaro (row 16 k31)

segments.en:
Jiron, huh...
Long time no see!

Timp!!
Today I'm finally gonna avenge
my dad and my mom!!

The statute of limitations ran out ages ago.
Time you forgot all about it!
Like I could ever forget!

Then what're you gonna
do about it, kid?!

What the?
Who are these guys!

Those are the Walker Machines
that were at the bazaar!
Hey, you!

Whoa!
They're shooting at us!

What do you think you're
doing, out of nowhere!

You still don't get it,
little lady?

You lot have officially
been branded "outlaws"!
Wh-What did you say?!!

Us...
"outlaws"...

Uh-oh.
We're surrounded.

Boys!
Let 'em have it!!
Eeeeek!
Damn it!

Elchi! At this rate, culture'll be
the least of our worries!!

It can't be helped.
Maybe we should abandon the Iron Gear...

Even if we abandon it, Grados
isn't gonna let us live, you know!

We won't know
unless we try!

Elchi!
You've gotta protect the Iron Gear!

Don't be ridiculous!
We've made Grados angry!

Oh...!
Now the Iron Gear won't
be able to do business...

If you don't protect
the Iron Gear for us,

then we soldiers can't fight
with everything we've got!
Jiron......
Real men have guts!

Jiron...?
What are you doing?!
Don't tell me... don't tell me...
Raaah, you bastaaaard!
Everyone, let's go!!
We'll do what we can!

Looks like talking still
won't get through to you...

Are the Walker Machines
ready?

Ready anytime,
Boss!

Good!
Go wild all you like!
You sure?

Then here
we go!

Heh heh!
Finally, an opponent with some backbone!

rows.notes: [jp] = "outlaws" (kept in quotes as in the source; also rows 13/18 neighbours). Seg 20 is tagged Rag but uses polite [jp] -- kept as Rag, sarcastic. Seg 22/25-26: Jiron is asking Elchi to defend the ship so the pilots can fight. Seg 28 [jp] rendered 'Real men have guts!' (no established English form found). Seg 7 [jp] read as Jiron hailing the Walker Machines. | [proofread 4] question: JP has [jp] then the vocative; '?!' (editorial flag) | [proofread 12] question ending in '!!' -> '?!!' (style sheet doubled form); same phrase is 'What did you say?!' elsewhere | [proofread 36] capitalisation: 'Boss' as a form of address (Timp's men), as at row 18 k6 and dlg_3986_09447_00

segments.en:
They're more stubborn than I thought.
Figured they were just a bunch of kids...
but they've got some real pros.
Still, they're badly outnumbered.

Damn!
There's so many of them!

This is
never-ending!
No whining!

If you're gonna do it, then
do it right, to the very end!

The captain's right.
Everyone, stay sharp!

Heh... Now it's just
a matter of time.

Boss!
We've got a transmission
from the Grados Army.

Hm...?
From the Grados Army?

Nwahahahahaha!
Kill 'em all!!

Ahaha.
So it's you.

Just wait a little longer.
I've almost got this wrapped up.
Ehahahaha!

I can feel it~
I can smell Eiji~

What's that?
That blue machine!

Isn't it obvious?
I'm gonna kill him!

There's actually some idiot
who'd help "outlaws"?!

What?
More of them?!
That thing moves fast...

That one's different from
the other Walker Machines!

That's no Walker Machine!
That's gotta be an "SPT"!!

An SPT...?
Then...!
That means the Grados Army!

This is bad!
Jiron!

Did we do something
wrong or what?!
I'm not giving up!!
Jiron...

It's moving to attack!!
Everyone, watch out!

Rei!
Activate V-MAX!!

Yikes!
What the heck was that attack?!

That SPT...
Is it on our side?

Hey, you there!
You gonna back us up?
Yeah...!

Ahh...
Talk about an angel in hell...

All riiight!
Let's go, everyone!!

What is that thing...
It's crazy fast.

No mistake about it!
That's the Layzner!
The finest SPT there is!
An SPT?!

What's the meaning
of this?!

He's a disgrace to Grados...
a filthy traitor!!

As the representative of Grados,
I'll finish him off myself!!

Well?
Ain't you grateful~?!

All right...
Lend me your strength.

Goood!
Hold out somehow
until I get there!!

So Grados isn't exactly
united either......

The situation's changed.
Looks like I need to size up
their strength a bit more.

When the time's right,
we pull back for now!

rows.notes: Seg 15: Gosterro's [jp] [jp] follows Timp's question about the blue machine; object left implicit in JP, rendered 'him' (= Eiji, male, whom he just named). Seg 26: AI [jp] = 'Rei' as in the Layzner library entry. Seg 31: [jp] = 'an angel in hell'. | [accuracy 18] verb/subject restored (Amuro about the blue SPT, next line 'That one's different'); was a verbless fragment

segments.en:
Argh! Damn it!
All that work for nothing?!

Walker Machines alone just
can't hold a candle to them...

Time to pull out.
All units, fall back!

Timp, you rat!
You're running away?!

Jiron!
Don't chase him too far!!

He's the one who killed my dad!
Let me go after him!!
Don't be reckless, Jiron!

Let go of me!
Let goooo!!

No!!
We're heading back to the Iron Gear.
Raaaaargh...!

Yikes...
Is Jiron gonna be okay?

When Timp's involved,
he just loses it.

Last time,
nobody could stop him, though...

Let's hurry back to
the Iron Gear, too.

Right.
Shall we go meet
our helper pilot?
So this is an SPT...

Yep, it's a whole other
beast from a Walker Machine.

Hey, Blume,
this is a Grados Army
machine, right?

Yeah...
It should be.

Did its pilot desert
from the army, or...
The pilot's coming down.

Is the person in charge
of this ship here?
Ah, um...

I'm the captain of this ship,
Elchi Cargo.

Welcome
to the Iron Gear.
My name is Eiji!

You people...
are being targeted by Grados!
Us...? Targeted by Grados?

Hey, hold on. This could just
be some rumor the Breakers
are spreading.

Eiji!
Are you sure your info's
right?

The Grados regular army
is already headed this way.

Anyway,
you need to get away from here.
Eiji has joined the unit.

Machine added:
Layzner
Eiji of the blue SPT...

Seems he's joined the Resistance
and is fighting Grados...

I don't know why the
Grados Army has its eye on us.

Either way... they're clearly an
enemy the Iron Gear can't
handle with its own strength...

rows.notes:
Segs 4-5: the pilot is still unidentified, so 'its pilot' / 'the pilot' instead of he/she (JP has no subject). | [editorial 19] system line aligned to the standard 'Machine added:
<name>' form
